sources.title: Asante Meeting Rooms official floor plan
sources.verification: Downloaded original public file; local signature or image decoding, byte count and SHA-256 verified against the source review.
limitations: The source image is undated and depicts one meeting-room level. The L1 identifier is retained from the prior schedule inventory; elevations and floor-to-floor height are not supplied by the plan.
Room boundaries follow visible walls and the movable partition. Wall thickness, small columns, door recesses and stair geometry are simplified; chairs and tables are omitted.
Relative drawing units are used. The published approximate rental areas and small furniture dimensions are not used to assert an architectural metric scale.
No reliable north angle or campus registration is established. The corrected campus map point and CAAN identify the venue but do not place this local indoor model on campus.
The original three-floor Asante W apartment layout remains preserved separately. Its 15 unscheduled shapes and service room 123D are not mixed into this meeting-room coordinate system.
